notes: *their* in *all their heart* is the only `added` unit: `כָּל־לֵבָב` writes no suffix, and rule 18's closing sentence makes a supplied possessive with no morpheme behind it `added`.
`כֻּלָּא` writes no *of it* here — the referent stands written as *Edom* — so `כֹּל` takes *all* and the suffix is unrepresented under rule 22, unlike EZK.36.10 where the ASV writes *all of it*.
